# Annetta Bell

## Overview

- **Origin:** Newbridge school district  <sub>[v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P6](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0006)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Annetta Bell is described as a pale, small individual. She has fine, silky, fawn-colored hair that falls over her shoulders in smooth ripples.

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P6](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0006)_

## History

Annetta Bell was a pupil taught by [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) during Anne's time as the schoolteacher in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). Along with her fellow classmates, she wrote a letter that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) compiled in a collection of classroom anecdotes sent to her friend [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md). When [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) eventually resigned from her teaching position to attend [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), Annetta and her fellow students were deeply saddened by her departure.

_Sources: [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P0](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0000), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P9](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0009), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P26](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0026), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P0](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0000), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P15](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0015), +2 more_

## Quotes

> "and I have come in to see you about something Clarice Almira told me when she came home to dinner today. It annoyed me excessively."
>
> — Annetta Bell — [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P13](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0013)

> "Clarice Almira told me that you pronounced our name Donnell. Now, Miss Shirley, the correct pronunciation of our name is Donnell . . . accent on the last syllable. I hope you’ll remember this in future."
>
> — Annetta Bell — [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P15](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0015)

> "It was all true, even if the minister wrote it first. I do love you with all my heart."
>
> — Annetta Bell — [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P29](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0029)

> "I am Mrs. Donnell . . . Mrs. H. B. Donnell,"

> — Annetta Bell — [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P13](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0013)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--annetta-bell.md)

Annetta Bell is one of the young pupils taught by [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) during Anne's tenure as the schoolteacher in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). As her teacher, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reads classroom compositions written by Annetta and her peers, and oversees the students through various chaotic schoolroom events. When [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) eventually resigns her post to attend [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), Annetta and the rest of the students express deep sorrow at losing her.

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P0](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0000), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P13](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0013), +13 more_
